title: A burst of new accounts opened in a short window with a shared pattern
definition: Many accounts opened within a short period, by different applicants, sharing characteristics such as a common address, a common device, a common contact number, or a common pattern of first transactions. The indicator measures the burst and the shared characteristics; it does not identify the organiser.
evidence_to_cite: the account opening records and the applications behind them
the evidence for each shared characteristic, cited by its own source id
the first transactions on each account
benign_explanations: A marketing campaign that brought in a cohort of customers at once.
A students' union or a sports club registering members in batches.
A payroll migration that moved staff onto a new platform.
An employer onboarding seasonal workers at the start of a season.

sources.citation: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, customer identification programme guidance, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
